evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies connection management, Tor control, and port mapping in src/net.cpp, src/torcontrol.cpp, and src/mapport.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an issue where disabling networking via `-networkactive=0` leaves background NAT-PMP port mapping queries and Tor control port reconnection attempts active. As noted in issue #34190, background retries and port mappings continued despite networking being marked inactive, violating expected isolation.
